notes.title: Penguins Redesigned!
notes.notes:
Hello dear Steam-ers!! We come bearing good news!
We are extremely excited to share that we just finished a huge milestone - redesigning the penguins!!! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689693/8ba40c5218ef6bf762d1a26760324b9d37cc66db.gif[/img]

We gathered a lot of feedback from players and we tried to apply as much as possible to make sure that we still keep the core of the original designs while trying to improve them in all ways possible.

We really hope you like it and would love to hear what you think about them!

Also, be sure to check out our new and improved trailer!

notes.title: Steam, we've arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey there, all you Steamers!
We are officially up and running with our spanking new Steam page for Laufen Und Raufen!! Hurray! :)))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689693/8ed59ccd8899867eb082674c52896a40ecacdead.png[/img]

What is the game you ask?
Well, Laufen Und Raufen is a chaotic brawler game for 2-8 players, where you slide into the shoes (or better yet, the flippers) of a penguin and you compete with your friends in various game modes who will win.

How many game modes will we have? A LOT!
Right now we have 2 game modes fully developed, 2 that we are still experimenting with and 2 more that we have planned. So... we have 6 in total, but we will see how many we could release in the end, because have to catch fish to feed our devs and our penguins. They may look sweet, but they are ruthless, vengeful yet cuddly animals.
We promise you this that you will have at the very least 4 game modes done for our release, so worry not, fellow penguin-lovers.

The mechanics are quite simple. You move with the analogue stick/keyboard arrow keys and you have only one other button - the push button!
In order for you to push the other players, you need to press and hold the push button, which is A on an XBox controller or the 0 key on the keyboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689693/817e8b970eaed2178429549856f86b045577c383.png[/img]
We kind of feel that we should mention that we are still very much deep in development so some small things might change here and there.
You know how it is, game development = changes = crying ourselves to sleep but smiling somehow through it.

Thanks a bunch for following us! We are planning some cool stuff to show you gals and guys that will blow you fish-filled minds!

So keep an eye out for our next update and until next time!

The penguins from Nurogames.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35689693/e607b5211fdbb463c44535968903504c568652f0.png[/img]
